title: Outcome Accuracy is Not Enough: Aligning the Reasoning Process of Reward Models
authors_zh: Binghai Wang、Yantao Liu、Yuxuan Liu、Tianyi Tang、Shenzhi Wang、Chang Gao、Chujie Zheng、Yichang Zhang、Le Yu、Shixuan Liu、Tao Gui、Qi Zhang、Xuanjing Huang、Bowen Yu、Fei Huang、Junyang Lin
paper_type_zh: 奖励模型理由一致性与混合奖励训练论文
best_for_zh: 需要检查奖励模型是否以正确理由作出判断、并把该检查用于强化学习的读者。
one_line: RationaleRM measures whether a reward model’s rationale agrees with atomic human reasons and uses that signal alongside outcome accuracy for RL.
RationaleRM 衡量奖励模型的理由是否与原子化人工理由一致，并将该信号与结果准确率共同用于强化学习。
why: It makes the connection between a data object and a training objective inspectable.
inclusion_reason: The paper changes how a training record, selection signal, reward, or trajectory is consumed by a post-training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A reward model can choose the right winner while relying on an irrelevant or incorrect justification. Optimizing only that outcome score can therefore reward a model that appears accurate but does not follow the reasoning humans intended.

This paper asks how to test and optimize the process behind a reward-model judgement. It separates outcome correctness from rationale consistency, using human checklists to determine whether the model’s stated reasons actually cover the reasons that matter.

奖励模型可以选出正确获胜者，却依赖无关或错误的理由。只优化结果分数因此可能奖励一个表面准确、却没有遵循人类预期推理的模型。

本文追问如何测试并优化奖励模型判断背后的过程。它把结果正确性与理由一致性分开，利用人工检查表判断模型陈述的理由是否真正覆盖重要原因。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central object is an answer pair with a human rationale decomposed into mutually exclusive atomic reasons, plus a model-generated rationale. The proposed MetaJudge performs strict one-to-one semantic matching between these two sets of reasons.

This yields Rationale Consistency as a process signal that cannot be inferred from a correct final choice alone. The official release includes the HelpSteer3 Human Checklist data and its atomic rationale annotations, making the matching target inspectable.

核心对象是一对回答及其被分解为相互排斥原子理由的人工理由，外加模型生成的理由。提出的 MetaJudge 在这两组理由之间执行严格的一对一语义匹配。

由此得到的理由一致性是一种不能仅从最终选择正确推断出的过程信号。官方发布包含 HelpSteer3 人工检查表数据及其原子理由标注，使匹配目标可以检查。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors construct atomic rationales from human checklist explanations and evaluate reward-model reasoning against them. They then form a hybrid reward that combines rationale consistency with outcome accuracy, and use the combined signal in group-relative policy optimization.

The construction keeps the judgement claim and the justification claim distinct: a reward model must make the right decision and substantiate it with matched reasons. That distinction lets the training objective penalize a plausible-looking explanation that does not correspond to the annotated evaluation basis.

作者从人工检查表解释中构造原子理由，并用其评估奖励模型推理。随后他们形成结合理由一致性与结果准确率的混合奖励，并将该信号用于组相对策略优化。

构造过程把判断主张和理由主张分开：奖励模型既要作出正确决定，也要用匹配的理由加以证实。这种区分使训练目标能够惩罚表面可信、却不对应标注评测依据的解释。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports 87.1 on RM-Bench and 82 on JudgeBench for its reward model, and reports an average gain of more than five points over outcome-only reward optimization. In its creative-writing RLHF experiment, it reports a seven-percent gain on Arena-Hard v2.

These findings support the stated hybrid objective in the reported preference and RL settings. They do not prove that checklist-derived rationales exhaust every valid explanation, or that a semantic matcher remains equally reliable when criteria, languages, or response styles change.

论文报告其奖励模型在 RM-Bench 上为 87.1、在 JudgeBench 上为 82，并报告相对只用结果的奖励优化平均提升超过五个点。在创意写作的强化学习人类反馈实验中，它报告 Arena-Hard v2 提升 7%。

这些发现支持所报告偏好和强化学习设置中的混合目标。它们并不证明从检查表导出的理由穷尽了所有有效解释，也不证明语义匹配器在标准、语言或回复风格变化时仍同样可靠。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Outcome-based reward modelling normally treats an accurate final preference as the supervision target. Process reward work can add free-form explanations, but may not have a test for whether those explanations correspond to the evaluator’s actual grounds.

RationaleRM introduces an explicit, atomic, one-to-one consistency target and makes it part of the reward used for optimization. The novelty is not simply asking a model to explain itself; it is turning explanation agreement into a measurable training signal alongside the outcome.

基于结果的奖励建模通常把准确的最终偏好当作监督目标。过程奖励工作可以加入自由文本解释，却可能没有测试这些解释是否对应评估者实际依据。

RationaleRM 引入明确的、原子化的一对一一致性目标，并把它纳入用于优化的奖励。新意不只是要求模型自我解释，而是把解释一致性转化为可测量、与结果并列的训练信号。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The method depends on human checklist quality, the completeness of atomic decomposition, and the semantic matcher. A rationale may be useful yet absent from the checklist, so users should measure annotator coverage and inspect false matches before treating consistency as a universal truth signal.
该方法依赖人工检查表质量、原子分解的完整性和语义匹配器。一个理由可能有用却未被写入检查表，因此使用者应测量标注者覆盖度并检查错误匹配，不能把一致性视为普遍真值信号。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it when an outcome-only reward model is suspected of exploiting shallow cues. Hold out checklist examples, compare outcome accuracy and rationale consistency separately, and only then test whether their combined reward improves a policy without degrading judgement quality on a separate evaluation set.
当怀疑只看结果的奖励模型在利用浅层线索时，可使用该工作。应留出检查表样本，分别比较结果准确率和理由一致性，然后才测试二者结合的奖励能否在独立评测集上不降低判断质量的前提下改进策略。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The critical audit is the gap between a correct verdict and a correct reason. Read the matching definition and the checklist construction before reading RL gains, because those two choices define what the process reward can and cannot certify.
关键审计点是正确结论与正确理由之间的差距。应先阅读匹配定义和检查表构造，再阅读强化学习增益，因为这两项选择决定过程奖励能够和不能证明什么。
